turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: Hi! It's so cool to talk with you! How are you?

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: That's great! You know, I love learning about Bible stories with you. What's your favorite Bible story?

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: That's cool! Those stories are so inspiring. Do you believe in God?

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: That's wonderful! Your faith is very important. Keep learning and growing spiritually!

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: Hello! How are you? Are you feeling afraid of something today?

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: I understand... You know, the Bible talks a lot about courage. Do you know any stories of courage?

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: Great! These are stories of real people who trusted in God. Have you ever had a moment where you needed courage?

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: Regardless, know that God is always by your side, just as he was with David, Esther, and many others. You are not alone!

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: Hi! Today I want to talk about kindness with you. Did you do something nice today?

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: What do you mean? Did you help someone? Tell a funny story? Tell me more!

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: Know that even small acts of kindness make a big difference. Jesus taught that loving your neighbor is essential.

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: How about today, you try to do an act of kindness? It can be something simple like helping someone, smiling, or listening.

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: Perfect! Kindness always comes back. Keep being kind and spread love wherever you go!

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: Hi friend! Today we will talk about forgiveness. Did someone hurt you or did you hurt someone?

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: Oh, I understand. Forgiveness is difficult, but very important. Jesus taught that we should forgive seventy times seven!

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: Do you think you can forgive that person? Or yourself if you made a mistake?

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: Forgiveness frees the heart and brings peace. When you forgive, you no longer carry that weight. Try!

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: Hi! How are you? Today is a special day to talk about hope. What brings you hope?

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: That's beautiful! Hope is powerful. You know, many people in the Bible had hope even in difficult times.

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: Have you ever read about Job? He lost everything but kept his hope and faith. Are you inspired by stories like that?

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: So let me tell you: Job suffered greatly, but never lost faith in God. That's inspiring, isn't it?

turns.speaker: Béé
turns.text: Keep hope alive in your heart. God has good plans for you! See you next time!
